areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: A component on tax administration relates to business environment and the indicators are suitable, but the area is not central and the resource share is modest, so impact is low.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: General and specific objectives directly related; all components include digital products, a digital-service indicator, viable targets and a relevant resource share, giving high impact.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Core objective of the programme; most components and about half of resources fit, with several SMART indicators; high impact but not exceptional.

areas.name: Women

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Only a minor solar-generation item on the proponent's own premises; negligible resources and negligible societal impact.

areas.name: Water security

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Transparency product exists, but the indicator measures executive-wide governance rather than fiscal transparency, and the resource share is small.

areas.name: State capacity
